phases.note: Missing/stale source invalidates effectiveness; confirmed replay authenticates actor first; grants/scopes/payloads/records are independent deep-frozen snapshots.

Shared AssistantStatePort consumed through an in-memory reference port. prepare is read-only; persistPending writes version 1; commit writes version 2 confirmed with main-owned effectCommandId, CAS and current-authorization revalidate/barrier; reject/expire/supersede append revisions. Decision adapter retains source message/conversation/digest and CAS revoke.

ReadIndexContextPort projects bounded project metadata/work/current contract JSON and an effective-decisions callback; stale contract returns contract_stale; archived/missing project is insufficient; preview exposes selected files, totals, omissions, injection flags and revalidation validity. Verification/delivery details remain summarized inside the work projection (no separate index port).

Zero-model vertical: real temp file context -> mock structured reasoner -> pending persisted proposal -> commit with effect command id/revalidate/barrier -> decision record -> new service instances (state reload) -> revoke/source disappearance. Commit failure leaves pending with no receipt; duplicate confirm replays; changed payload/foreign actor/cross-project/expired grant/supersession covered. Real temporary-SQLite adapter remains NOT_TESTED because A has not published AssistantStatePort.
Copyable prepare/persistPending/commit consumer and adapter mapping documented. Main still owns HTTP/provider/UI wiring and decision command composition; no product enablement is claimed.
